info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API provides a seamless way for users to check the current status of their parking reservations. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can retrieve detailed information about reservation statuses, ensuring effective management of parking resources. This API is particularly useful for application developers implementing features that allow users to track their parking reservations in real-time. Typical consumers include parking management applications and mobile apps that facilitate user engagement with parking services.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of their reservations. It provides essential information regarding whether the reservations are confirmed, pending, or canceled, enabling users to manage their bookings effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of reservations. Ensure that all required fields are present to obtain accurate and relevant information regarding the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current reservations status.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of reservations.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit information related to the reservation.
